_about: This shows what tools/roblox.json holds. `python3 tools/publish/publish.py setup` writes the real one for you. It holds ids only, so it's safe to commit. Never put the API key in it.
_universeId: Creator Hub → Creations → hover over your game → ⋯ → Copy Universe ID
_placeId: Creator Hub → your game → Places → click the start place: it's the number in the address (…/places/<id>/configure)
_userId: Open your Roblox profile: it's the number in the address (roblox.com/users/<id>/profile)
groupId: <only if a group owns the game; otherwise leave this line out>
_keychainService: The name your API key is saved under in the macOS Keychain
